annotations.title: Find songs in the CucuTime catalog

description: Find existing CucuTime kids’ songs and educational videos on YouTube by words in their titles (English, Spanish or Portuguese; most videos are in Spanish and Portuguese). Useful when a parent or teacher wants songs or videos to watch or play: animal characters, dance, early learning (colors, shapes, numbers, emotions) and a few daily habits or routines (bedtime, teeth, tidying up) for home or preschool. Generic words (song, routine, kids, preschool) are ignored and a few everyday topics (birthday, bedtime, teeth, tidying up, colors, numbers, letters, shapes, emotions, body) also match their usual title words; any other word must appear in a title, so search one simple word and check suggestions and approximate alternatives when there are no exact matches. Returns YouTube links. Free, no key, no AI.

language.description: Only videos in this language (most are Spanish or Portuguese; few are English). Omit for any language.

query.description: One simple word from video titles in the target language, such as an animal, a learning topic or a habit (e.g. elefante, baila, colores, emociones, dormir, dientes, ordenar). Generic words are ignored and everyday topics match their usual title words; any other word must appear in the title, so avoid long phrases and never send a child’s name. Empty = latest uploads.
